title: Jordan National Railway (Aqaba-Amman freight corridor)
summary_2_lines: $2.3bn Jordan-UAE JV signed Apr 2026; 360 km Phase 1 links Aqaba port to Shidiya/Ghor Al-Safi (~16M t/yr). Northern extension toward Madounah (Amman) and Syria/Turkiye planned.
notes: Signed Apr 2026, execution phase (freight-first). Amman-corridor uplift is future/unfunded - impact_area not citywide, so not applied to Amman pricing.

title: Marsa Zayed waterfront mega-development (Aqaba)
summary_2_lines: $10bn mixed-use waterfront city in Aqaba, under implementation since 2024; 3.2 km2 of high-rise residential, marina, retail, hotels and business districts.
notes: Aqaba appreciation catalyst; not an Amman signal.

title: Amman Metro - planning/feasibility only (NOT built)
summary_2_lines: Amman Metro remains at feasibility/planning stage; a CREM (China Railway) study confirmed the topography is viable. No funding, route or construction start. Operational mass transit today is the BRT, not a metro.
notes: Explicitly speculative - corrects any assumption the metro is built/under construction. Low confidence keeps its future-signal weight negligible.
